text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Alright then... let's settle this clearly.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I prepared this as a recreation. If we're gonna do something, this will sting way more than some lukewarm board game, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah! Make this French-bread bastard all soggy like milk-soaked mush!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Please wait, we cannot decide the Christmas party policy with such a rough contest! I—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well, if you don't wanna join, fine. No matter how much you try to stop us, we'll move as we like. Just enjoying the endless back-and-forth.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Blackjack. We'll let Gold Ship be the dealer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Five games in total. If your hand gets closer to 21 than the dealer's, you earn 1 point. Whoever scores more wins. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I'll reveal one of my two cards. Ta-daa! It's an 8! Are you drawing another card from the deck?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (My hand is 5 and 3. Face cards count as 10, Ace as 1 or 11. Then... there's room to draw.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I will hit!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: I'll hit too. Alright, bring it! ...Dub-on, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The score is a fierce 2 to 2! Last game, let's go!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (The dealer's hand... at most probably 16. I currently have 18. If I stand, then surely—)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Not gonna hit, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's tied up to now. Pretty boring safe play, isn't it, Meno? You're trying to go with a “sure win” hand again, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But that's dull. Humans' hearts race when they get results that exceed expectations.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Fine, I'll reveal my hand. Two cards make 19. Drawing another one is too risky.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But I'm hitting. Drawing a 2 here is what makes a gambler.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: W-what meaning is there in doing that!? And it's reckless! The deck isn't low either, aiming for a 2 here is—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. A nearly impossible miracle! A reckless stunt full of risk! But that's what makes it hot.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Safe developments are boring. When you place expectations and surpass them—there lies true excitement!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hit.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (...!! This pressure... could it be... they're serious...!?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Come, card number 2...!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: What were you even trying to do!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hahahahaha! But it was amusing. A fitting moment for amusement.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The moment you flip is the hottest! That was great to watch! Mamechin, your chest must've been dancing like crazy!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh...! Th-that is... no, my hand is 18! My victory! The match is over!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: What, with 18 you can still go. Hit, why don't you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You felt the thrill, didn't you? Just now, when I flipped the card. That heartbeat of expectation—you want to taste it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Even if you fail, the score stays tied. It’ll just go to extra rounds. Not much risk.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Plenty of big numbers have already appeared, so the odds of drawing a 3 or less aren't low. C’mon—let's chase the dream.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (If I draw 3 or less here... it’ll be amazing. A perfect victory. Honestly... it's hot.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (...I'm expecting it. Maybe with this hand... I could pull off a miraculous win...!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Fine then! I'll hit!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Come on...!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama & Meno
text_block_list.text: ...It’s a 3.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama & Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ha... hahahaHAHAHAHA!! Amazing, Mamechin! You’re blessed with luck!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: O... oh... ooooh...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (I... drew it... with my own hand... 21. Neither bust nor safe...)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...My heart... it's hot... I'm surprised—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It’s sizzling hype, right!? Party games should be this hot and fun!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah... but... then... was your goal... to make it fun? Not just fooling around...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Of course! Christmas needs “surprises beyond expectations.” It's written on the scroll in Santa’s training hall!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...A surprise... beyond expectations...

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Wow! A police uniform!

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Why why!? Meno asked Santa for a police notebook! But this... a uniform! A hat! A notebook and flag too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno’s Mother
text_block_list.text: My my. Meno was such a good girl this year. I'm sure it's a reward from Santa. Right, dear?

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Dad!! Didn't you say today was “big investigation” day!? That you couldn’t come home—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno’s Father
text_block_list.text: I wrapped it up quickly. Tonight we can spend Christmas together.

text_block_list.name: Young Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: !! Then let's play police together! Arrest, arreest!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (I never imagined it... a Christmas present beyond what I expected. And Dad came home early too.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (I was shocked, so happy... I kept asking to play police again and again. Laughing so much—)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...My heart became hot...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: A dull banquet is meaningless. Only beyond prediction and expectation does true excitement of the people await.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Thus your plan needed improvement.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...For everyone’s sake? Even the fireworks... thinking of everyone...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Naturally. That is the duty of a king. If I oversee an event, mediocrity is never allowed.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Of course, we know that you worked hard to provide a wonderful time for everyone, Meno-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: But because of that... don’t you think you can aim even higher? A Christmas party that exceeds expectations.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A Christmas party... that exceeds expectations...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Everyone is looking forward to the Christmas party, hoping for something wonderful. Just like I hoped for a present from Santa long ago.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Exceeding that expectation... brings true joy. And beyond that—surely, everyone’s excitement and smiles.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let’s aim for it together. The best Christmas party that surpasses everyone’s expectations!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: But I will enforce discipline! That part will be strictly monitored!!
